WITH stg_transactions AS (
    SELECT * FROM `banking_catalog`.`dbt_staging`.`stg_transactions`
),

dim_account AS (
    SELECT * FROM `banking_catalog`.`dbt_marts`.`dim_account`
    WHERE is_current = TRUE
),

dim_customer AS (
    SELECT * FROM `banking_catalog`.`dbt_marts`.`dim_customer`
    WHERE is_current = TRUE
),

joined AS (
    SELECT
        -- Surrogate key for the fact row
        md5(cast(concat(coalesce(cast(txn.transaction_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_'), '-', coalesce(cast(txn.account_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')) as string))                                       AS fact_transaction_id,

        -- Foreign keys to dimensions
        da.dim_account_id,
        dc.dim_customer_id,

        -- Degenerate / natural keys kept on the fact
        txn.transaction_id,
        txn.account_id,
        da.customer_id,

        -- Date / time grain
        txn.transaction_ts,
        CAST(txn.transaction_ts AS DATE)            AS transaction_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', txn.transaction_ts)     AS transaction_month,
        DATE_TRUNC('year',  txn.transaction_ts)     AS transaction_year,

        -- Measures
        txn.amount                                  AS transaction_amount,

        -- Categorised amounts (positive = credit, negative = debit)
        CASE WHEN txn.amount >= 0
             THEN txn.amount
             ELSE 0
        END                                         AS credit_amount,

        CASE WHEN txn.amount < 0
             THEN ABS(txn.amount)
             ELSE 0
        END                                         AS debit_amount,

        -- Descriptive attributes carried forward from dimensions
        da.account_type_cd,
        da.account_balance                          AS account_balance_at_time,

        -- Audit columns
        
  current_timestamp() as stg_loaded_at,
  '0deb2d51-0ecd-4db9-a8d9-ce0b08729119' as invocation_id,
  'demo_dbt_profile' as target_user


    FROM stg_transactions AS txn

    LEFT JOIN dim_account AS da
        ON txn.account_id = da.account_id

    LEFT JOIN dim_customer AS dc
        ON da.customer_id = dc.customer_id
)

SELECT * FROM joined
